items.name: ECC
items.summary: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
items.summary_en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

items.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
items.summary: 该项目将 Andrej Karpathy 关于大语言模型编程常见陷阱的观察提炼成一个 CLAUDE.md 文件，用于优化 Claude Code 的行为。它通过编码最佳实践（如避免过早优化、确保显式错误处理）充当系统提示，引导模型生成更安全、更可靠的代码。开发者只需将此文件放入项目根目录，即可立即改善 Claude 的代码生成质量。这是一个轻量级但实用的工具，适合所有使用 LLM 辅助编程的开发者，帮助他们避免常见错误，提升代码质量。
items.summary_en: This project distills Andrej Karpathy's insights on common LLM coding pitfalls into a single CLAUDE.md file that guides Claude Code to produce better outputs. By encoding best practices like avoiding premature optimization and ensuring explicit error handling, it acts as a system prompt for safer, more reliable code generation. Developers can drop this file into any project to instantly improve Claude's behavior, making it a practical tool for anyone using LLM-assisted coding.

items.name: n8n
items.summary: n8n是一款公平代码工作流自动化平台，通过可视化界面让开发者无需依赖特定供应商即可构建复杂的数据集成流程。其核心设计巧妙结合了拖拽式工作流编排与随时插入自定义JavaScript/TypeScript代码的能力，既保持了低代码平台的易用性，又提供了开发者所需的灵活控制权。该平台支持自托管或云端部署，可连接400多种服务，用户可快速搭建从AI数据处理到业务自动化的各类工作流，特别适合需要兼顾开发效率与系统自主权的团队进行流程自动化实
items.summary_en: n8n is a fair-code workflow automation platform that enables developers to visually build complex data integrations without vendor lock-in. Its key innovation is combining drag-and-drop workflow design with the flexibility to inject custom JavaScript/TypeScript code at any node, bridging low-code accessibility with developer control. You can deploy it as a self-hosted solution or use the cloud version, connecting to 400+ services to automate everything from AI pipelines to business processes while maintaining full data ownership and customization capabilities.

items.name: AI-Infra-Guard
items.summary: AI-Infra-Guard 是腾讯开源的全栈 AI 红队平台，用于系统性地发现智能体、大模型应用及其基础设施中的安全风险。它整合了 Agent 扫描、技能扫描、MCP 工具扫描、AI 基础设施扫描以及 LLM 越狱评测能力，将复杂的 AI 攻击面结构化。其核心思路是把大模型生态当作可测试的系统，通过自动化手段模拟提示注入、越狱等攻击。你可以用它对自己的 LLM 应用进行安全评估，提前发现供应链和工具链中的薄弱点，从而加固 AI 系统的整体防御。
items.summary_en: AI-Infra-Guard is a full-stack AI red-teaming platform from Tencent that helps security teams probe AI ecosystems for vulnerabilities. It combines agent behavior scanning, skills and MCP tool analysis, infrastructure checks, and LLM jailbreak evaluation into a unified workflow. Technically, it treats AI systems as complex attack surfaces, enabling automated scans of agents and their toolchains. You can use it to assess your own LLM applications, test for prompt injection and jailbreak resilience, and harden AI deployment pipelines.

items.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
items.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
items.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

items.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF
items.summary: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF 是基于 Qwen3 混合专家架构的代码模型，总参数量30B但每个token仅激活3B，兼具高性能与低开销。它通过 Unsloth 的 GGUF 量化，可在普通本地设备上以4-8比特精度运行，适合代码补全、生成、修复等场景。开源且兼容多种推理框架，既是离线编程助手的理想内核，也可作为微调基底。开发时无需云端API，数据更安全。
items.summary_en: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF is an efficient, open-source code model built on Qwen3's mixture-of-experts architecture. It activates only 3B of 30B parameters per token, delivering strong coding abilities at a fraction of the compute. Unsloth's GGUF quantization makes it practical to run locally on consumer hardware, from 4-bit to 8-bit precision. Use it for code completion, generation, bug fixing, or as a backend for development tools without cloud dependency. Its compact footprint and Apache-2.0 license make it a flexible baseline for fine-tuning or building coding assistants.

items.name: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B
items.summary: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B是一个轻量级自动语音识别模型，目标是以小模型实现高效准确的语音转文字。它通过优化的Transformer架构和训练方法，在0.6B参数下取得不错的识别精度，并保持低延迟，适合边缘设备和实时应用。模型以Apache-2.0开源，提供Safetensors权重，可直接运行，也支持微调适配特定领域。你可以用它开发语音转录工具、字幕生成器或语音交互界面，在手机和服务器上灵活部署。
items.summary_en: Qwen3-ASR-0.6B is a compact automatic speech recognition model that transcribes speech to text efficiently while requiring minimal compute. Its strength lies in balancing a small parameter count (0.6B) with solid accuracy, making it suitable for resource-constrained devices and real-time pipelines. Technically, it leverages the Qwen3 ASR architecture with Safetensors weights and Apache-2.0 licensing. In practice, you can fine-tune it for specific languages or domains, or integrate it directly into applications for transcription, subtitles, and voice commands, whether on edge devices or in the cloud.

items.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 是一个高效的句子嵌入模型，能将文本转换为有意义的向量表示，用于计算语义相似度。它通过知识蒸馏技术从大型模型中学习，仅用2270万参数就实现了接近大模型的性能，特别适合资源受限环境。开发者可通过Hugging Face快速调用该模型，应用于智能搜索、文档聚类或内容推荐等场景，探索语义理解在实际项目中的潜力。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
items.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
